title: Girl has 8 NDEs and learns the purpose of suffering on Earth

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Repeatedly describes standing beside/near her body watching events (e.g., hospital room; watching foster mother resuscitate).
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Also describes impartiality; worry at times (e.g., 'Will we have time?').

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Also reports 'void/womb' darkness with pink flashes; and some transitions were 'instant' or not sensed.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Tunnel vision during strangulation/fainting; sometimes 'sort of a tunnel, but instant.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A 'Jesus' figure in an STE; a Buddhist monk form in the later NDE; both explicitly treated as forms/appearances rather than literal identity.
arrival.other_being_detail: Primary guide described as 'Being of light' / 'attendant' / 'friend' (humanoid-shaped light), not fully definable; also 'Great Intelligence' (creator Presence).

environment.environment_other_detail: Multiple realms: 'Presence' of Great Intelligence; space/stars/planets; underwater planet with bioluminescent beings and honeycomb caverns; two-sun planet with grown crystalline cities; 'womb/void' darkness with pink flashes; Greek-temple-like gathering with marble pillars and 3D 'universe floor'; clouds; 'train station' parable scene.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Also returns because she had 'promised' and felt 'powerful draw' / commitment; sometimes return prompted by need to 'get back if you're going.'
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Often 'instant' return or unspecified; one return described as waking coughing/vomiting; last return in 'a pool of bloody vomit.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Framed as having 'work to do' and that if she didn't return 'much will fail'; later parable implies choosing an 'impossible life' to try not to fail; purpose teaching emphasizes choosing love/existing to sustain creation.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple events: childhood strangulation/abuse with resuscitation and hospital; possible drowning/resuscitation; later fainting/syncope due to very low blood pressure; also STE after 3-day fast/prayer.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Heavily Seventh Day Adventist indoctrination ages nine to fifteen (later than earliest childhood NDEs).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard: interplanetary/space travel; 'womb of creation' void; Greek-temple gathering/conference; 'train station' incarnation-ticket parable; 'download' answers to 'why'; claimed time-stoppage relative to Earth during excursion.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Often OBE → guide encounter → other realms/Presence → teaching → return; sometimes tunnel first (syncope/STE) or 'instant' relocation without sensed transition.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple NDEs (~8) with recurring guide/Presence/light and returns.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Detailed reports of visiting non-Earth planets and intelligent species; 'surfing on sound' and tasting colors; 'womb of creation' as a memory-place; Greek-temple-like gathering with attendants; parable-like 'ticket station' for choosing incarnations; explicit claim of replaying a doctor/foster-parent conversation verbatim after OBE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Remember exactly what they say.' / 'You don't have to go back. It's your choice.' / 'Earth is a place where the unlimited becomes limited; where the singular becomes many.' / 'Someone must. Why not me?'
